info.title: Mnemic API — contract foundation
info.description: Partial contract for health, feature flag management and project-scoped belief APIs (Issue #24). Other implemented API families and the online documentation page are not included yet. Error type URIs are stable identifiers, not guaranteed live web pages.

put.summary: Replace all feature flags with revision checking
put.description: JSON-only full replacement, no query parameters. Audit and update are atomic; unchanged flags do not increase revision or write an audit. Unsupported true flags (retrieval_entity, retrieval_time, decay, reranker, read_time_resolution) return 400 before database access even though their syntactic type is boolean. Cache-Control: no-store.

get.summary: List project beliefs with filters and offset pagination
get.description: Operator scope, not per-user ownership. Unknown query keys are ignored. Default status active, server limit 200 (max 1000), offset 0. q is literal case-insensitive subject/attribute containment, not value search. Missing projects return an empty list. Order is subject then attribute; offset pages are not a stable snapshot during concurrent changes. No model calls.

200.description: Current values with numeric scores; missing source type is null.

post.summary: Correct a belief with user-correction authority
post.description: Synchronous standard ingest/resolver path with USER_CORRECTION provenance. Deleted beliefs must be explicitly restored first (409); retracted beliefs may be revived. Body requires a nonempty string; unknown keys are stripped, whitespace is not trimmed. Query keys ignored. No extraction or embedding model call. This does not provide write-side secret detection; do not submit credentials as corrections.
